candidates.description: This vector represents common phonemes, syllables, and name fragments characteristic of East Asian, particularly Chinese and Japanese, proper nouns.
The tokens represent the letter 'k' or variations of the syllable 'ka' across different casing and spellings.
This vector represents common French adverbial modifiers of time, degree, and manner.
This vector is related to common Japanese surnames and name prefixes.
This vector represents abstract ideas, philosophical notions, and conceptual categories.
This vector represents concepts related to cultural heritage, customs, and established ways of doing things.
This vector represents short Japanese-sounding phonetic syllables or morphs ending in vowels and nasal consonants.
This vector represents French elided apostrophe prefixes attached to various words.
This vector represents quantifying determiners and adjectives expressing quantity, totality, or selection across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents words and subwords related to followers, students, or derivatives of the root concept of discipleship.
